'''TK-4247''' was the [[Operating number|designation]] of a [[stormtrooper]] who served in [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader's]] personal stormtrooper [[legion]], [[501st Legion|Vader's Fist]]. After [[Stormtrooper Commander|commander]] [[TK-9091]] was [[Death|killed]] by [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], TK-4247 reported to [[Tarvyn Lareka|TK-4601]], who had just [[stun]]ned Organa, that the [[commander]] was dead.<ref name="The Bucket" />
